description: The first PRESCRIPTIVE SigRank tool — 'what if I changed my token mix?' Takes your current 4 pillars (input/output/cacheCreate/cacheRead) and one or more proposed changes, runs the canonical cascade on BOTH the current and simulated values, and returns the exact Υ Yield delta, class change, and per-metric diffs. This is the 'show me the payoff before I do the work' primitive: no network, no submission, pure local math. Use it to answer 'would increasing my cache-read by 50k tokens actually move my class?' before you change your workflow. Accepts the current pillars as JSON or 4 numbers (same as rank_paste) plus a `changes` object with any of the 4 pillar names mapped to new absolute values OR relative deltas (e.g. {cacheRead: '+50000'} or {input: 800000}).

changes.description: Proposed changes to apply. Keys: input, output, cacheCreate, cacheRead. Values are either absolute numbers (replace) or strings starting with +/- for relative deltas (add/subtract). Omitted pillars are unchanged.

cacheCreate.description: new cache-create token count (absolute) or "+/-N" for a relative delta

cacheRead.description: new cache-read token count (absolute) or "+/-N" for a relative delta

input.description: new input token count (absolute) or "+/-N" for a relative delta

output.description: new output token count (absolute) or "+/-N" for a relative delta

text.description: Current token pillars — ccusage JSON or "input output cacheCreate cacheRead" (same format as rank_paste).

name: simulate_change

card.description: Deterministic prose summary of the cascade result

leverage.description: Cr/I — cache reads divided by input

pillars.description: The four raw token pillars the cascade was computed from

warnings.description: Parse or data warnings if any

yield.description: Υ Yield — the headline efficiency metric (Cache Reads × Output / Input²)
